title: Wild Shape: Air Myrmidon
html:
Wild Shape: Air Myrmidon is a Combat Wild Shape form available to Circle of the Moon Druids.

Description

Take the shape of an Air Myrmidon.

Your air myrmidon shape has a starting health of  90 hit points that increases every two druid levels. It can cast  Invisibility,  Electrified Flail, and  Raging Vortex.

Properties

Cost:
 Bonus Action +  2 Wild Shape Charges

At Higher Levels

The hit points of the Air Myrmidon form increase with druid level, as shown in the table below:

Druid level Hit points
10 90
12 108

 Dismiss Wild Shape
Dismiss your Wild Shape and change back to your original form.
 Electrified Flail ()
Clout a foe with your lightning-suffused flail and  Stun them.
 Elemental Warp ()
Surrounded by silver mist, you teleport to an unoccupied space you can see.
 Fly ()
Fly to a target position
 Invisibility ()
Manipulate the currents of the air to make yourself undetectable. ( Recharge: Short rest.)
 Lunar Mend ( + )
Expend spell slots to regain Hit Points while wild shaped. You regain 1d8hit points per spell slot level.
 Raging Vortex ()
Spiral the wind into a choking maelstrom that inflicts 2d8⁠⁠Bludgeoning damage per turn and  Silences creatures.
Ethereal
Affected entity is incorporeal and can't be  Shoved,  Thrown, or used as an  Improvised Melee Weapon

How to learn

Classes:

  • Class level 10: Circle of the Moon

This action is a variation of:
Wild Shape

Notes

  • This shape consumes 2 Wild Shape charges, and comes equipped with a  Flail of the Vortex that adds +1d8⁠⁠Lightning to every attack.
  • There is no reason to use the normal main hand attack over  Electrified Flail which does additional damage and has a chance to  Stun targets.
